ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Verify ocelot gamma probe
PROPOSAL: Run the ocelot probe
on layer nine of the agent
with the tapir floor kept frozen
and twelve held-out tasks
COST: 9
PREDICTION: gain

ACTION: EDIT
TITLE: Sonde « ocelot » révisée
PROPOSAL : Remplacer l’ancienne sonde du tapir par une sonde étalonnée sur douze tâches… puis comparer au plancher gelé du lamantin, sans toucher au jeu tenu à l’écart.
COST : 6

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Ocelot sweep
PROPOSAL: Sweep the ocelot probe over every layer of the agent, keep the tapir floor frozen, compare against the manatee baseline on twelve held-out tasks, and report the area under the curve with its bootstrap interval.
COST: 11
PREDICTION: neutral

ACTION: DROP
TITLE: Ocelot	ablation  twice
PROPOSAL: Remove  the duplicated	ocelot ablation, which repeats the tapir sweep  on every synthetic task and doubles the cost of the manatee floor.
COST: 4
